items.claim: Jackson McVey uses deep kicks to manage range and has a busy jab.
items.quote: He'll use deep kicks to try to manage that range. He's got a busy jab.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has poor takedown defense.
Wesley Schultz was a 47-0 high school wrestler and an All-American in junior college and D3.
items.quote: Before that, he was 47-0 in high school. Then he went to a junior college where he was all-American. Then he went to a D3 school to wrestle and he was all-American there as well.
His striking is absolutely [ __ ] non-existent as well.
